prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 500Lクラス冷蔵庫6機種の比較 (language ja).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "機種" spans 1 col × 2 row; "性能" spans 3 col × 1 row; "価格（税込）" spans 1 col × 2 row; "特徴（長い説明）" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "機種" · longest unbreakable word 68px · one-line width 188px
  col 2: header "性能 › 消費電力" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 82px
  col 3: header "性能 › 容量" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 41px
  col 4: header "性能 › 騒音" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 56px
  col 5: header "価格（税込）" · longest unbreakable word 59px · one-line width 92px
  col 6: header "特徴（長い説明）" · longest unbreakable word 56px · one-line width 1295px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"500Lクラスの冷蔵庫6機種を、性能・税込価格・特徴から比較して選ぶための表。","reading":"機種名を手がかりに行を追い、消費電力・容量・騒音・価格を縦に見比べたうえで、特徴の説明を読む。説明文が行の高さを決めやすいため、その高さの中で機種名が折り返されても行全体を読みやすく保てる。","groups":["消費電力・容量・騒音は「性能」の下に並ぶ数値指標で、同じ機種内でも機種間でも比較する。","機種名と価格は各行の識別と選択の目安になり、性能値や特徴と対応づけて読む。","特徴は各機種の違いを文章で説明する欄で、数値列より広い幅と複数行を許容できる。"],"keep_intact":["型番や数値と単位、税込価格は可能な限り分断しない。","容量・騒音などの短い比較値は、縦に素早く見比べられるよう一行を優先する。"],"may_wrap":["特徴の説明文は意味のまとまりに沿って複数行に折り返せる。","機種名はメーカー名と型番の間で折り返せるが、型番自体は保ちたい。","幅を特徴に回す案では、消費電力や騒音の値が折り返される可能性がある。"]}
